summary: The exact candidate is a valid narrow parser correction for clean, schema-disambiguated DeepSeek V4 arguments/args envelopes in one-shot and streaming parsing. It is not a full fix for the original report: it cannot reconstruct corrupted inner command content, repair syntactically invalid inner JSON, disambiguate free-form schemas, or verify model-side retry escalation without the named model.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction. All clean envelope cases failed in one-shot and streaming parsing; boundary expectations also showed that the base retained every outer envelope. Raw output is preserved outside the checkout in /job/review-evidence-j-9116207b5667/base-independent.txt.

Independent adversarial suite verified clean object, JSON-string, args, mixed repeated, and repeatedly encoded envelopes across one-shot and streaming chunk sizes 1, 2, 3, 7, and 64. It also verified preservation of irrecoverable corruption, declared arguments properties, unknown keys, mixed top-level objects, and free-form schemas.
Candidate focused regression suite: 11 passed, 10 subtests passed.
Broader existing function-call parser suite: 243 passed, 4 subtests passed.
Confirmed the tested import resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/function_call/deepseekv4_detector.py.

gpu_execution.evidence: A gfx950 / AMD Instinct MI350X was visible, but the reviewed change is deterministic Python parser logic and required no GPU execution. No model-level claim is based on a startup smoke.

remaining_counterexamples: Mid-stream duplication or corruption of inner command text remains unrecoverable from the emitted payload and is not corrected by the candidate.
A quadruple-wrapped payload whose innermost JSON/string is syntactically damaged cannot be normalized into valid tool arguments without guessing.
Schemas without a usable declared top-level property set retain an added envelope because it is indistinguishable from a legitimate free-form arguments or args key.
The model-side validation-error escalation loop was not reproduced or corrected.
remaining_limitations: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp weights were unavailable, so generation frequency, vision/model semantics, mid-stream generation corruption, and retry escalation were not tested end to end.
The tiny Llama fixture is a different architecture and was not used as substitute evidence.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; no multi-GPU or distributed behavior was tested.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
